verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an API-first email service, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation and sunset policy. The published OpenAPI spec, SDKs, and MCP server are related developer surfaces, but none of them shows versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
